text_sheet.text: WHERE THE MECHANICAL DESIGN UTILIZES A PLENUM RETURN AIR CEILING DESIGN, ALL EQUIPMENT AND MATERIALS INSTALLED WITHIN THE PLENUM RETURN CEILING MUST MEET THE FLAME SPREAD AND SMOKE DEVELOPED RATINGS OF 25/50 AND BE APPROVED FOR USE IN PLENUM RETURN CEILINGS. COORDINATE PLENUM CEILING LOCATIONS WITH THE MECHANICAL CONTRACTOR. COORDINATE ALL DEVICE LOCATIONS AND CIRCUIT ROUTING WITHIN ANY MILLWORK WITH MILLWORK VENDOR PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.   COORDINATE THE CONNECTIONS OF ALL EQUIPMENT PROVIDED BY OTHERS WITH THE CONTRACTOR PROVIDING THE EQUIPMENT PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN. THIS INCLUDES, BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO, MECHANICAL 	EQUIPMENT, AUDIO/VISUAL EQUIPMENT, FIRE SUPPRESSION SYSTEM EQUIPMENT, FIRE ALARM EQUIPMENT, ETC. PROVIDE THE APPROPRIATE DISCONNECTING MEANS FOR, AND TO MAKE THE FINAL CONNECTION TO, ANY HARDWIRED EQUIPMENT. THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR IS ALSO RESPONSIBLE TO PROVIDE AN APPROPRIATE CORD AND PLUG FOR ANY CORD-AND-PLUG CONNECTED EQUIPMENT THAT IS NOT EQUIPPED WITH AN INTEGRAL CORD AND PLUG. SEE PANEL SCHEDULES FOR INFORMATION ON CIRCUITS THAT ARE TO BE ROUTED THROUGH CONTACTORS OR RELAYS FOR CONTROL.  ALL EQUIPMENT AND DEVICES SHALL BE SUITABLE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT IN WHICH THEY ARE INSTALLED. EQUIPMENT MOUNTED OUTDOORS SHALL BE NEMA 3R. DEVICES MOUNTED IN DAMP OR WET LOCATIONS SHALL BE WEATHERPROOF. RECEPTACLES RATED 15- OR 20-AMPS AND 120 VOLTS WHICH ARE LOCATED IN DAMP OR WET LOCATIONS SHALL BE GFCI PROTECTED AND EQUIPPED WITH A SUITABLE WEATHERPROOF COVERPLATE (WHILE-IN-USE IN WET LOCATIONS). ALL LUGS, TERMINALS, ETC. IN ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT SHALL BE LISTED FOR A MINIMUM OF 75 DEGREE C CONDUCTORS. TERMINATIONS LISTED FOR ONLY 60 DEGREE C CONDUCTORS ARE NOT PERMITTED.COORDINATE WITH ALL OTHER TRADES TO PROVIDE ALL CODE-REQUIRED CLEARANCES AROUND ELECTRICAL CONNECTION AND CONTROLS COMPARTMENTS IN ALL EQUIPMENT WHICH IS PROVIDED BY OTHERS AND CONNECTED BY THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SUCH AS, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, HVAC EQUIPMENT.   PROVIDE NEMA 5-20R RATED RECEPTACLES AT ALL CARDIO EQUIPMENT LOCATION.

GFCI FACEPLATE RECEPTACLE ABOVE COUNTER, COORDINATE MOUNTING HEIGHT WITH TENANT.HAND DRYER MOUNTED AT 42" AFF.PROVIDE A GFCI DUPLEX RECEPTACLE MOUNTED BELOW COUNTERTOP FOR CONNECTION OF AUTOMATIC FAUCET SENSOR. ENSURE PLUMBING PIPING WILL NOT INTERFERE WITH MOUNTING LOCATION AND COORDINATE ALL REQUIREMENTS WITH PLUMBING CONTRACTOR PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.HYDROMASSAGE UNIT. 240 VOLT, 30 AMP DEDICATED OUTLET WITH NEMA L6-30 LOCKING RECEPTACLE. A 120-VOLT, NEMA 5-15 DUPLEX RECEPTACLE FOR TOUCHSCREEN IS ALSO REQUIRED.TANNING AND HYBRID BED/BOOTH. 240 VOLTS, THREE PHASE, 40 AMP DEDICATED CIRCUIT. PROVIDE APPROXIMATELY 6 FEET OF #8 AWG WIRE OUT OF THE LEFT SIDE OF THE BACK PANEL THROUGH 1-INCH LIQUID TIGHT FLEX CONNECTOR. THIS WIRE MUST BE SLEEVED WITH FLEX AND BROUGHT INTO A JUNCTION BOX/DISCONNECT. THIS LENGTH OF WIRE IS NECESSARY TO MOVE THE UNIT FOR SERVICE. COORDINATE WITH ARCHITECT FOR FINAL POWER CONNECTION PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.PROVIDE ISOLATED GROUND FOR CHECK-IN COMPUTER/PRINTER RECEPTACLES. POWER AND DATA SHALL RUN IN TRENCH BELOW CHECK IN AREA. COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION WITH ARCHITECTURAL PLANS. POWER AND DATA SHALL RUN IN SEPARATE CONDUITS/RACEWAYS.PHONE JACK AND RECEPTACLE FOR T-MAX MANAGER TANNING BED CONTROL. WIRE TO TIMER AT EACH TANNING ROOM AS REQUIRED. SEE LOW VOLTAGE PLAN ON SHEET E-600 FOR T-MAX TIMER LOCATIONS. PROVIDE A SINGLE GANG BOX SHIELDED CAT-5 FROM TMAX CONTROLLER AT DESK THROUGH EACH GANG BOX, TERMINATE IN LAST ROOM.LOCATION OF DATA RACK AND TELEVISION DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM. COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION OF RECEPTACLES WITH A/V VENDOR.COORDINATE LOCATION OF BACKWRAP AND CHECK-IN RECEPTACLES WITH TENANT PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.COORDINATE TV MOUNTING HEIGHT AND CONNECTION REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.MOUNT RECEPTACLE SERVING DRINKING FOUNTAIN BELOW UNIT PER MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE.POWER AND DATA SHALL BE RAN ABOVE FLOOR FROM END OF STAR-LINE RACEWAY TO NEARESTCOLUMN OR FULL HEIGHT WALL. COORDINATE EXACT REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER PRIOR TOORDER AND/OR INSTALLATION. PROVIDE SEPARATE CONDUIT/RACEWAYS FOR POWER. COMPLY WITHNEC 310.15. ENSURE ALL WIRE BETWEEN COLUMN AND RACEWAY JUNCTION BOX IS PROTECTED. CONFIRM FEEDER ROUTING AND INSTALLATION WITH PLANET FITNESS REPRESENTATIVE PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.COORDINATE CLUB COMM CONNECTIONS WITH LOW VOLTAGE VENDOR.BEVERAGE COOLER, PROVIDE DEDICATED RECEPTACLE ON GFCI CIRCUIT BREAKER PER MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS.POWER CONNECTION FOR FUTURE SIGNAGE. COORDINATE LOCATION AND ALL REQUIREMENTS WITH SIGN CONTRACTOR PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN. PROVIDE AN APPROPRIATE LOCAL DISCONNECTING MEANS MOUNTED IN AN ACCESSIBLE, INCONSPICUOUS LOCATION THAT IS WITHIN SIGHT OF THE SIGN OR WITH LOCKABLE MEANS.COORDINATE ELECTRICAL REQUIREMENTS WITH FAN MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.PROVIDE POKE‑THROUGH assembly FOR POWER AND DATA SERVING THE MASSAGE CHAIRS. run all conduit and wiring in ceiling of the space below back to source panel. provide separate conduit for power and data WHERE REQUIRED. coordinate all poke-through location AND CONDUIT ROUTING with the landlord, architect, and planet fitness representative prior to installation. comply with nec 310.15.PROVIDE PROVISIONAL POWER FOR FUTURE EQUIPMENT. DOOR TO ELECTRICAL ROOM MUST OPEN IN THE DIRECTION OF EGRESS (OPENING OUTWARD DIRECTION) AS PER NEC 110.26(C)(3); PERSONNEL DOORS.PROVIDE CONDUIT AND WIRING DOWN THE SURFACE OF THE WALL FROM ABOVE TO A JUNCTION BOX AT THE END OF THE GRATEFUL HOME SYSTEM RACEWAY. PROVIDE SEPARATE CONDUIT FOR POWER AND DATA WHERE REQUIRED. COORDINATE CONDUIT ROUTING AND INSTALLATION WITH PLANET FITNESS REPRESENTATIVE PRIOR TO ROUGH‑IN. COMPLY WITH NEC 310.15.PROVIDE POKE‑THROUGH FOR POWER AND DATA BENEATH THE CHECK‑IN COUNTER. ROUTE CONDUIT AND WIRING IN THE CEILING OF THE SPACE BELOW TO THE BACK WALL OF THE CHECK‑IN AREA AND UP IN A FULL‑HEIGHT WALL. PROVIDE SEPARATE CONDUIT FOR POWER AND DATA WHERE REQUIRED. coordinate all poke-through locationS AND CONDUIT ROUTING with the landlord, architect, and planet fitness representative prior to installation. comply with nec 310.15.

ANY EXISTING CONDITIONS INDICATED IN THIS SET OF DRAWINGS ARE BASED ON INFORMATION PROVIDED BY OTHERS AND POSSIBLE LIMITED FIELD VERIFICATION. ADJUST FOR ACTUAL FIELD CONDITIONS AT NO ADDITIONAL EXPENSE TO THE OWNER.VISIT THE PROJECT SITE, REVIEW EXISTING CONDITIONS AGAINST THE CONTRACT DOCUMENTS, AND BECOME FAMILIAR WITH THE WORK PRIOR TO BIDDING AND START OF THE WORK. SIGNING THE CONTRACT IS AN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT THAT THE SITE VISIT HAS BEEN COMPLETED AND THE EXISTING CONDITIONS ARE ACCEPTED.DEMOLISH ANY EXISTING EQUIPMENT, DEVICES, AND LUMINAIRES AS INDICATED AND/OR AS REQUIRED TO ALLOW FOR INSTALLATION AND CONSTRUCTION OF THE NEW WORK. REMOVE ALL EQUIPMENT, DEVICES, LUMINAIRES, CONDUITS, SUPPORTS, HANGERS, ETC. THAT ARE NOT SHOWN AND ARE REQUIRED TO BE REMOVED IN ORDER TO COMPLETE THE NEW WORK.ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS THAT ARE TO BE REMOVED SHALL BE REMOVED IN THEIR ENTIRETY. CONDUCTORS SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE ITEM TO BE DEMOLISHED TO THE SOURCE OF OVERCURRENT PROTECTION. RACEWAYS WHICH ARE INSTALLED IN OR BELOW FLOORS OR WITHIN WALLS MAY BE ABANDONED, BUT ALL OVERHEAD OR EXPOSED RACEWAYS SHALL BE REMOVED. EXPOSED RACEWAYS TO BE ABANDONED SHALL BE REMOVED AND SHALL BE CUT OR CHISELED AT LEAST 2" INTO THE WALL OR FLOOR AND THE OPENING GROUTED SMOOTH.THE OWNER SHALL HAVE SALVAGE RIGHTS TO ANY ITEMS THAT ARE TO BE DEMOLISHED. THOSE ITEMS THAT THE OWNER WISHES TO SALVAGE SHALL BE CAREFULLY REMOVED AND STORED IN A LOCATION AS DIRECTED BY THE OWNER. ALL OTHER ITEMS OF DEMOLITION SHALL BECOME THE PROPERTY OF THE CONTRACTOR AND SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE SITE.PROVIDE TEMPORARY CIRCUITS AND CONNECTIONS TO EQUIPMENT, LUMINAIRES, OR DEVICES IN AREAS OF THE FACILITY THAT ARE TO REMAIN IN OPERATION AS REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN THOSE AREAS IN COMPLETE OPERATION.MAINTAIN CONTINUITY OF EXISTING CIRCUITS AS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE POWER TO REMAINING EQUIPMENT AND DEVICES THAT ARE NOT BEING REMOVED.PROVIDE BLANK COVERPLATES FOR EXISTING EMPTY DEVICE BOXES OR JUNCTION BOXES THAT MUST REMAIN, SUCH AS FOR CIRCUITS THAT MUST BE MAINTAINED TO OTHER AREAS.WHERE ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT (PANELBOARDS, SWITCHBOARDS, ETC.) IS TO BE REMOVED OR RELOCATED, ALL EXISTING CIRCUITS THAT ARE TO REMAIN SHALL BE RECONNECTED TO NEW OR RELOCATED ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT TO MAINTAIN THE CONTINUITY OF THOSE EXISTING CIRCUITS. INTERCEPT AND EXTEND ALL EXISTING CIRCUITS AS REQUIRED. REMOVE ALL ABANDONED TELECOMMUNICATIONS CABLING.
